# components/split-pane

Import: `import { SplitPane } from "@tundralibs/ui/split-pane"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `SplitPane`

```ts
SplitPane(props: SplitPaneProps): Html
```

Two panes with a draggable divider. The start pane's share is the
`--split-start` custom property, which split-pane.js sets from the
`data-split-initial` attribute, a stored value, a pointer drag, the
arrow keys (±2%), Home/End, or a double-click (reset). The divider is a
`role="separator"` with `aria-valuenow`. Below 768px the panes stack and
the divider hides unless `keep`. Without the script the panes split at
`initial`.

## Types

### `SplitPaneOrientation`

Side by side (`horizontal`, the divider is vertical) or stacked (`vertical`).

- `"horizontal"`
- `"vertical"`

### `SplitPaneProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: the separator's `aria-controls` and the storage key default derive from it. |
| `start` | `Html` | yes | The first pane (left / top). |
| `end` | `Html` | yes | The second pane (right / bottom). |
| `orientation` | `SplitPaneOrientation` |  |  |
| `initial` | `number` |  | Start pane's share, in percent. @default 50 |
| `min` | `number` |  | Smallest start share, in percent. @default 20 |
| `max` | `number` |  | Largest start share, in percent. @default 80 |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  | Persist the position in localStorage under this key. |
| `label` | `string` |  | The separator's accessible name. @default "Resize panes" |
| `keep` | `boolean` |  | Keep the panes side by side on a phone (by default they stack below 768px). |
| `padded` | `boolean` |  | Pad both panes (content that is not already a card or a list). |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | The box is `--split-height` tall (24rem) when vertical, at least that when horizontal — retune it in `attrs.class`'s own rule. |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Editor beside its preview

The position is remembered under `storageKey`; below 768px the panes stack.

```ts
SplitPane({
  id: "editor-split",
  storageKey: "editor-split",
  start: html`<textarea class="textarea" aria-label="Source"></textarea>`,
  end: html`<div id="preview" data-load data-action="/preview"></div>`,
})
```

```html
<div class="split-pane split-pane--horizontal" id="editor-split" data-split-pane="" data-split-initial="50" data-split-min="20" data-split-max="80" data-split-storage="editor-split">
  <div class="split-pane__pane split-pane__pane--start" id="editor-split-start">
    <textarea class="textarea" aria-label="Source"></textarea>
  </div>
  <div class="split-pane__separator" role="separator" tabindex="0" aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize panes" aria-controls="editor-split-start" aria-valuenow="50" aria-valuemin="20" aria-valuemax="80" data-split-separator="">
    <span class="split-pane__grip">
      <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="split-pane__pane split-pane__pane--end" id="editor-split-end">
    <div id="preview" data-load data-action="/preview"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### A narrow list and a detail pane

```ts
SplitPane({
  id: "mail-split",
  initial: 30,
  min: 20,
  max: 50,
  label: "Resize the message list",
  start: html`
    <ul class="menu__list">
      <li><a class="menu__link" href="/mail/1">Welcome</a></li>
    </ul>
  `,
  end: html`
    <article>
      <h2>Welcome</h2>
    </article>
  `,
})
```

```html
<div class="split-pane split-pane--horizontal" id="mail-split" data-split-pane="" data-split-initial="30" data-split-min="20" data-split-max="50">
  <div class="split-pane__pane split-pane__pane--start" id="mail-split-start">
    <ul class="menu__list">
      <li>
        <a class="menu__link" href="/mail/1">Welcome</a>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div class="split-pane__separator" role="separator" tabindex="0" aria-orientation="vertical" aria-label="Resize the message list" aria-controls="mail-split-start" aria-valuenow="30" aria-valuemin="20" aria-valuemax="50" data-split-separator="">
    <span class="split-pane__grip">
      <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
  </div>
  <div class="split-pane__pane split-pane__pane--end" id="mail-split-end">
    <article>
      <h2>Welcome</h2>
    </article>
  </div>
</div>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/split-pane/split-pane.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.split-pane`, `.split-pane--horizontal`, `.split-pane--keep`, `.split-pane--padded`, `.split-pane--vertical`, `.split-pane__grip`, `.split-pane__pane`, `.split-pane__pane--end`, `.split-pane__pane--start`, `.split-pane__separator`

## Behaviour

`components/split-pane/split-pane.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-split-initial`, `data-split-max`, `data-split-min`, `data-split-pane`, `data-split-ready`, `data-split-separator`, `data-split-storage`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`, `split:change`.
